influences.name: The Rolling Stones
influences.context: If we're having a party, we won't be sticking on an AC/DC record, it'll be the Stones, Chuck Berry, Little Richard, that kinda bag.

influences.name: Elvis
influences.context: I'm not trying to compare myself to Elvis, and I never saw him live, but if I had done I'd have wanted to remember him being young and wearing one of his rock'n'roll outfits.
